llm.reason: The caller claims to have found documents linked to your account and is building a case-like story, which is a common opening for fake police or 'digital arrest' scams. No genuine official starts this way on a phone call.
llm.advice: Do not share any details or money; hang up and verify only through your bank's official number or by visiting the police station yourself.
